name: Fintraffic Digitraffic weather cameras
notes: GeoJSON. One station has many presets; {id} is the preset id (C0150301), not the station id. 406 without Accept-Encoding: gzip.

name: Caltrans CWWP2 CCTV
notes: One file per district 1-12, zero padded. Image URL is per camera in data[].cctv.imageData.static.currentImageURL; skip inService == "false".

name: TfL JamCams
notes: Values are {key, value} pairs in additionalProperties[]. {id} is the numeric part of id, e.g. 00002.00865. 831 of 890 are available.

name: foto-webcam.eu
license: Embedding allowed with a link back
notes: HTML index page, no API. {id} is the name in /webcam/{id}/current/400.jpg. Unknown names answer 404 text/html, so check content-type.

name: PANOMAX panoramas
notes: No list endpoint, ids come from panomax.com. The day listing gives a slot every 10 minutes and tile dimensions, not image URLs. Tiled panoramas.
